reason: A settings-panel plugin for managing local DeepSeek Harness sessions, including listing, resuming, outline preview, and permanent deletion with host-side persistence and agent lifecycle handling.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中提供本机会话列表、继续、活动大纲预览和永久删除功能。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness settings panel for listing, resuming, previewing, and permanently deleting local sessions.

capabilities: Lists local sessions and their statuses
Resumes existing sessions through the browser session service
Previews recent session history and activity statistics
Permanently deletes sessions and related managed child sessions
Stops active agents before session deletion
Deletes JSONL or SQLite session persistence data
Exposes a host-side session deletion RPC
